title: State-transfer interventions in adaptive decision-tree populations under concept drift: companion software and evidence
description: Companion software, locked protocols, analysis-ready data and reproducibility evidence for two confirmatory studies of state-transfer interventions in adaptive decision-tree populations under concept drift. The deposit uses a file-level multi-licence: original software and validation code are distributed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, while original protocols, documentation and generated evidence are distributed under CC BY-NC 4.0. See LICENSE-POLICY.md and licensing/licence-map.json in the archive.
